name: ValuationSettings
description: User-level settings controlling automatic value refresh and snapshot generation. One document per user. Applies across all modules (whiskeykeeper, pipekeeper, cigarkeeper, winekeeper).

created_by.description: Email of the user these settings belong to

auto_value_refresh_enabled.description: Whether scheduled automatic value refresh is enabled for this user

value_refresh_cadence.description: How often the scheduler should refresh item values

auto_generate_snapshots.description: Whether to automatically create a new ItemValueSnapshot on each scheduled refresh run

refresh_on_item_create.description: Whether to compute and snapshot value immediately when a new item is created

refresh_on_first_view_if_missing.description: Whether to auto-generate a first snapshot when a detail page is opened and no snapshots exist

last_auto_refresh_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent successful scheduled auto-refresh run for this user
